title: Salczek the Fleshgrinder
summary: Salczek the Fleshgrinder becomes dangerous to nearby attackers as his health falls.
overview: Salczek the Fleshgrinder becomes dangerous to nearby attackers as his health falls.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: At 40% health, Salczek gains area rampage. Keep vulnerable group members away from his melee range.
At 20%, area rampage becomes more frequent. Reserve defensive abilities and additional melee healing for the finish.
After five minutes out of combat, the scripted rampage state resets.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
